articles.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need', but analysts warn of volatility
articles.summary: "Anthropic's IPO is exactly what the markets need to revive overall sentiment," said Rebecca Walser, chief investment officer at Walser Wealth Management, adding that markets have been "depressed with all of the negativity in the AI complex over the past several weeks." While the initial pop was not surprising for such a highly anticipated listing, investors should avoid "chasing the IPO," Walser said.

articles.title: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
articles.summary: Shares of Japan's SoftBank Group plunged 16.16% on Friday, leading a broader sell-off in Asian technology stocks following the highly anticipated market debut of artificial intelligence startup Anthropic. The sharp decline underscores growing investor concerns over SoftBank's aggressive bets on artificial intelligence, particularly its exposure to OpenAI, as markets question whether massive investments in AI infrastructure will generate sufficient returns.

articles.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
articles.summary: Core inflation in Japan soared to a fresh high in 2026, coming in at 2.2% in October as higher energy costs and their knock-on effects pushed up prices in the wider economy. Japan has reportedly approved reintroduction of energy subsidies in December to stave off higher imported energy prices as higher prices crimp growth, hitting consumption and net exports.

articles.title: Anthropic was supposed to save the AI trade. What went wrong?
articles.summary: Investors had been looking forward to the Anthropic IPO as a "clearing event" — reviving the tech sector after months of choppy trading, the Nvidia espionage scandal, and growing concerns that AI chip sales to Asia are likely to slump as Washington cracks down on potential violations of export controls.

articles.title: Lumentum CEO defends Marvell deal after stock plunge: 'We've got work to do' with shareholders
articles.summary: The merger would combine Marvell's semiconductor and networking technology with Lumentum's optical components as AI data centers increasingly shift from copper wiring to fiber-optic connections to handle faster data transmission. To be sure, the dramatic decline in both Marvell and Lumentum shares isn't entirely due to the investor displeasure with the planned transaction.

articles.title: Here's how big Anthropic’s record-setting IPO is: Visualization
articles.summary: The AI company sold 930 million shares at $83 each, the biggest initial public offering on record.

articles.title: Cramer says Nvidia’s woes are trumping Anthropic excitement for the rest of the AI trade
articles.summary: Nvidia's deepening sell-off following last week's leadership shake-up is overwhelming the optimism surrounding Anthropic's stock market debut and hurting the rest of the artificial intelligence trade, CNBC's Jim Cramer argued Thursday. As the longtime leader of the AI trade, the chipmaker has helped drive investor enthusiasm for everything from semiconductor manufacturers to data center infrastructure companies.

articles.title: California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion
articles.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia on Thursday as part of a probe of whether the company's advanced semiconductor chips ended up in China in contravention of U.S. "The conduct of Nvidia and its former CEO raises bright red flags, including about the ways in which the company may have misled investors," Bonta said in a statement.

articles.title: Palo Alto stock jumps on earnings beat and company's big bet on securing open-weight models
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks shares rose 6% on Thursday as businesses boosted spending on cybersecurity products and investors cheered the company's acquisition of a startup that pushes it into securing open-weight artificial intelligence models. Those fears have led more businesses to consolidate platforms, which is fueling growth in areas like firewall and AI security, Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora told CNBC's "Mad Money" on Wednesday.

articles.title: Congress passes bill to protect older investors from financial fraud
articles.summary: The bill would generally allow mutual fund companies and their transfer agents, which handle shareholder records and transactions, to temporarily delay paying out redemption requests when they suspect an older or otherwise vulnerable investor is being financially exploited. "This legislation fills an important regulatory gap that can help protect vulnerable investors before assets are lost." The measure's congressional approval comes amid growing financial fraud among older Americans.

articles.title: Kraken parent's acquisition of Tribe Capital flags new chapter in evolution of crypto exchanges
articles.summary: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is pushing into private markets with its latest acquisition, underscoring a broader shift in cryptocurrencies, from trading-led growth to the buildout of financial infrastructure. "Joining Payward gives us the opportunity to bring Tribe's investment approach to a global financial platform," Jonathan Hsu, another co-founder of Tribe Capital, said in a statement.

articles.title: Trump bought Nvidia, Palantir, SpaceX in September as federal deals, White House ties grew
articles.summary: President Donald Trump's investment accounts bought shares of Nvidia, Palantir and Elon Musk's SpaceX in September, around the time the companies secured major federal contracts and their executives met with the president, according to a newly released financial disclosure. articles.title: Gold's bad year is getting worse. Why its price keeps falling
articles.summary: Precious metals investors can be forgiven if they feel like the past year has given them whiplash. Which role it plays depends on the factors dominating the market and the psyche of investors, and right now, it's the currency argument that is bringing the precious metal down.
